claim: No multi-device or concurrent-edit conflict policy exists.
decision_blocker: The governing multi-device/concurrent-edit policy path is not captured; Packet 04 remains unexecuted for exact storage identities and concurrency contracts; no bounded two-client conflict receipt exists; private or external synchronization settings are not represented by a digest-bound receipt.
missing_proof: No same-scope current source proves version vectors, ETags/If-Match, compare-and-swap, optimistic concurrency, merge/hold rules, stale-write rejection, or an explicit single-device boundary. The cleanup conflict resolver is out of scope; the applicability overlay proves conditional contact, not policy existence; Packet 03 assigns owners but does not implement the policy.
reopening_condition: Re-evaluate when a current policy, explicit single-device boundary, Packet 04/20 completion receipt, concurrency implementation, private/external configuration receipt, or bounded two-client conflict test is added or changed.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main anchor; exact active storage/backend/Notes/GitHub configuration; two independently identified sessions or devices; stable logical record identity; captured initial revision/version; privacy-safe credentials; network and retry settings; exact policy and implementation digests.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Open one logical record from two independently identified clients, create divergent edits from the same starting revision, submit both under controlled clock skew and retry conditions, and verify the second stale write is rejected, merged deterministically, or held for explicit adjudication without silent overwrite.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Receipt containing anchor commit, policy/config/source digests, initial record hash and revision, privacy-safe client pseudonyms, two divergent payload hashes, submission order and timestamps, request version/ETag fields, both responses, final record hash/revision, and an explicit boolean that silent overwrite did not occur.
unresolved_authoritative_path: A current digest-bound synchronization/concurrency policy governing the same logical record across device, session, Notes, backend, and GitHub surfaces; or an explicit authoritative single-device/no-concurrent-edit boundary. Private and external configuration must be represented by privacy-safe receipts.
